# PHP
> The official PHP website provides downloads, manuals, language reference, installation guides, and community resources for the PHP programming language.

PHP.net is the canonical source for PHP releases, documentation, function and extension references, migration guides, and project participation information maintained by The PHP Group.

## Core Documentation
- [Documentation](https://www.php.net/docs.php): Entry point to the official PHP manuals, references, and translated documentation.
- [Getting Started](https://www.php.net/manual/en/getting-started.php): Introductory guide for learning PHP installation, basics, and first steps.
- [Introduction](https://www.php.net/manual/en/introduction.php): Overview of PHP, its capabilities, and common usage patterns.
- [A simple tutorial](https://www.php.net/manual/en/tutorial.php): Beginner tutorial covering basic PHP syntax and web scripting concepts.
- [Language Reference](https://www.php.net/manual/en/langref.php): Central index for PHP language syntax, semantics, and core constructs.
- [Function Reference](https://www.php.net/manual/en/funcref.php): Index of built-in PHP functions organized by extension and module.
- [Appendices](https://www.php.net/manual/en/appendices.php): Supplemental reference material including reserved words, migration, and configuration details.

## Language Basics
- [Basic syntax](https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.basic-syntax.php): Fundamental PHP syntax rules, tags, statements, and code structure.
- [Types](https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.types.php): Overview of PHP data types and type system behavior.
- [Variables](https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.variables.php): Rules for declaring, assigning, and using variables in PHP.
- [Constants](https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.constants.php): Definition and usage of constants and magic constants.
- [Expressions](https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.expressions.php): Explanation of expressions, evaluation, and value handling in PHP.
- [Operators](https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.operators.php): Reference for arithmetic, comparison, logical, and other operators.
- [Control Structures](https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.control-structures.php): Conditional statements, loops, and flow-control constructs.

## Functions and Object-Oriented Programming
- [Functions](https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.functions.php): Defining, calling, and organizing functions including arguments and returns.
- [Classes and Objects](https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.oop5.php): Object-oriented programming concepts including classes, inheritance, and visibility.
- [Namespaces](https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.namespaces.php): Organizing code and resolving names with PHP namespaces.
- [Enumerations](https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.enumerations.php): Native enum support for modeling fixed sets of values.
- [Errors](https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.errors.php): Error handling model, exceptions, and reporting behavior in PHP.
- [Attributes](https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.attributes.php): Native metadata annotations for classes, methods, properties, and functions.
- [Generators](https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.generators.php): Lazy iteration and coroutine-style workflows using generators.

## Installation and Setup
- [Installation and Configuration](https://www.php.net/manual/en/install.php): Main installation guide for supported platforms and environments.
- [Linux and Unix Installation](https://www.php.net/manual/en/install.unix.php): Build and installation instructions for Unix-like systems.
- [macOS Installation](https://www.php.net/manual/en/install.macosx.php): Platform-specific installation guidance for macOS environments.
- [Windows Installation](https://www.php.net/manual/en/install.windows.php): Installing and configuring PHP on Windows systems.
- [Runtime Configuration](https://www.php.net/manual/en/configuration.php): php.ini settings, directives, and runtime configuration behavior.
- [Command Line Usage](https://www.php.net/manual/en/features.commandline.php): Using PHP from the shell for scripts, tooling, and automation.

## Extensions and APIs
- [Function Reference](https://www.php.net/manual/en/funcref.php): Complete catalog of built-in functions grouped by extension.
- [Extensions and Related Documentation](https://www.php.net/manual/en/extensions.php): Overview of bundled and external PHP extensions.
- [PDO](https://www.php.net/manual/en/book.pdo.php): Database abstraction layer for consistent access to multiple databases.
- [MySQLi](https://www.php.net/manual/en/book.mysqli.php): Improved MySQL extension with prepared statements and advanced features.
- [cURL](https://www.php.net/manual/en/book.curl.php): HTTP and network transfer functions using libcurl.
- [JSON](https://www.php.net/manual/en/book.json.php): Encoding and decoding JSON data in PHP applications.
- [OpenSSL](https://www.php.net/manual/en/book.openssl.php): Cryptographic and TLS-related functions backed by OpenSSL.
- [Session Handling](https://www.php.net/manual/en/book.session.php): Managing session state for web applications.

## Security, Features, and Best Practices
- [Security](https://www.php.net/manual/en/security.php): Security guidance for writing and deploying safer PHP applications.
- [Features](https://www.php.net/manual/en/features.php): Overview of major PHP language and runtime capabilities.
- [Handling file uploads](https://www.php.net/manual/en/features.file-upload.php): Secure processing of uploaded files in web applications.
- [Sessions](https://www.php.net/manual/en/features.sessions.php): Session concepts, configuration, and usage patterns.
- [Garbage Collection](https://www.php.net/manual/en/features.gc.php): Automatic memory management and cycle collection behavior.
- [HTTP authentication](https://www.php.net/manual/en/features.http-auth.php): Implementing HTTP authentication with PHP scripts.

## Migration and Versioning
- [Migration Guide](https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration.php): Index of migration notes for upgrading between PHP versions.
- [Migrating from PHP 8.4.x to PHP 8.5.x](https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration85.php): Backward-incompatible changes and new features in PHP 8.5.
- [Migrating from PHP 8.3.x to PHP 8.4.x](https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration84.php): Upgrade notes, deprecations, and compatibility changes for PHP 8.4.
- [Migrating from PHP 8.2.x to PHP 8.3.x](https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration83.php): New features and compatibility considerations for PHP 8.3.
- [Migrating from PHP 8.1.x to PHP 8.2.x](https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration82.php): Language and runtime changes introduced in PHP 8.2.
- [Supported Versions](https://www.php.net/supported-versions.php): Current support status and lifecycle information for PHP releases.
- [Downloads](https://www.php.net/downloads.php): Official source and binary downloads for current PHP versions.

## Releases and Change Information
- [News](https://www.php.net/news.php): Release announcements and project news from the PHP team.
- [ChangeLog](https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-8.php): Version-specific changelog entries for PHP 8 releases.
- [PHP 8 ChangeLog](https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-8.php): Detailed fixes and changes across PHP 8.x versions.
- [PHP 7 ChangeLog](https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-7.php): Historical changelog for PHP 7 release series.
- [Release Process](https://www.php.net/releases/): Information and resources related to PHP release management.
- [QA and Testing](https://qa.php.net/): Quality assurance resources for testing release candidates and snapshots.

## Contributing and Community
- [Get Involved](https://www.php.net/get-involved.php): Ways to contribute to PHP development, documentation, and community efforts.
- [Help](https://www.php.net/support.php): Official support resources, documentation help, and community assistance channels.
- [Contact](https://www.php.net/contact.php): Contact information for the PHP project and related teams.
- [Other PHP.net sites](https://www.php.net/sites.php): Directory of official PHP project websites and services.
- [My PHP.net](https://www.php.net/my.php): Personalized PHP.net settings and preferences for documentation browsing.
- [PHP License](https://www.php.net/copyright.php): Copyright and licensing information for PHP and site content.
- [GitHub Web Source](https://github.com/php/web-php/blob/master/index.php): Source code for the PHP.net homepage implementation.

## Reference and Search Tools
- [Manual](https://www.php.net/manual/en/): Full English PHP manual with searchable language and extension documentation.
- [FAQ](https://www.php.net/manual/en/faq.php): Frequently asked questions about PHP usage, installation, and behavior.
- [Reserved Keywords](https://www.php.net/manual/en/reserved.php): Reserved words, predefined constants, and naming restrictions.
- [INI Core Directives](https://www.php.net/manual/en/ini.core.php): Core php.ini directives and their configuration semantics.
- [Predefined Variables](https://www.php.net/manual/en/reserved.variables.php): Superglobals and predefined variables available in PHP scripts.
- [PHP Tags](https://www.php.net/manual/en/language.basic-syntax.phptags.php): Detailed reference for PHP opening and closing tags.
